description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git repository operations, such as merging, resetting, conflict resolution, and related workflows. It sets up multiple repositories, performs various Git commands, and verifies the expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository with specified name.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests complete.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path is missing.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a file or output is empty.
